provenance.input_policy: Inert JSON reads only; no source words or fetched code executed.

receipt_selection: Only result_files named by this registry snapshot; no glob-based latest-run selection or skipped-family execution.
reference_convention: All paths are relative to the repository root. JSON Pointers follow RFC 6901 and are checked against the hashed input bytes.

registry_snapshot.budgets_note: budget_core_minutes are the 12-core-plan estimates from PLAN.md; on a 128-core machine wall time divides accordingly but per-worker RSS caps stay (pipeline/pool.py).
registry_snapshot.criteria: PLAN.md section 6: >= 3 words incl. both families; CR >= 1.5 vs N1 and >= 1.2 vs N1b; motif enrichment >= 2x at q < 0.01; falsifiable prediction checkable in <= 1 core-hour; held-out check; non-circular (not a profile restatement)

experiments.pass_bar: PASS only if both variants rebuild all original successors exactly and all swapped sequences receive a classification from the local predicates/frame guards without an unexplained auditor rejection. Otherwise EXPLORATORY with the missing local guard or reconstruction obligation. Both seeds must agree.
experiments.scope: Only these named local operations at the pinned prefixes. Invalid named orders are guard-domain failures, not a claim that no alternate derivation exists. Different admitted words are not an order-dependent value for a fixed algebraic sum of Parikh deltas. No global kappa root/price is computed. Two early lineage decomposition obligations remain unchanged.
experiments.title: Guarded local-order follow-up to L7 scope review

experiments.pass_bar: All 152 primary full-moment estimates have matching signs and <=2 percent relative error for every nonzero conditional local-root change; repeat with second seed. Pairwise ranking, other scores and 33 companions are descriptive controls.
experiments.scope: No complete global/idle near-miss profiles are held. Hyperplane word files were overwritten by the source producer. Preserve these limitations and full source/PINS attribution in the result; do not execute fetched source.
